spans.s:
अङ् is the substitute of च्लि after the verbs पुष् 'to nourish' and the rest; द्युत् 'to shine' and the rest; and the verbs having an indicatory ऌ , when the affixes of the परस्मैपद follow.

Terms: च्लि

The words पुष्य and सिद्ध्य् are irregularly formed by the affix क्यप् , when used as names of asterisms.

Terms: क्यप्

The affix इनि (इन्) comes in the sense of मतुप् after the words पुष्कर etc. when the word so formed denotes a locality.

Terms: इनि (इन्)
